notes.title: Steam Deck Playable
notes.content:
The game has received the "Steam Deck Playable" qualification!

This small update fixes the screen adaptation of the game, so that it doesn't break on uncommon resolutions/aspect ratios.

If you find any bug, please let me know here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2340790/discussions/0/3821910883993583205/

notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a couple of bugs.
[*] Made deleting a chapter progress more intuitive
[*] By default, autocaps and autopunct are off
[*] Changed the leaderboard order
[/list]

That's all for now.
Thanks for playing the game!

If you find any issue, please, let me know here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2340790/discussions/0/3821910883993583205/
